video.title: Recording video
video.codec_x264_note: Encodes on the processor: pick it if GPU encoding fails or you prefer it; heavier, consider 720p/30 fps.
video.transcoding_note: Records at source, delivers with lanczos on save (sharp text).
video.upscale_warn: Above your monitor: heavier file, zero extra detail.
video.disk_note: Lower resolutions only save disk space. For maximum quality use Source.
video.judder_note: 30 fps saves GPU but judders more on high-refresh monitors; 60 fps is smoother for action.
video.estimate: CBR {{bitrate}} kbps · ~{{ram}} MB per 60 s in RAM
video.hq_note: Fixed HQ: CBR + P7 + high quality + AQ (verified NVENC recipe, no knobs to turn).
